passages.note: House final passage, Thurston voted Yea; 6 Nays of a 75-member body is under 10%, so the vote cannot carry a chair alone.
passages.actor_quote: Stratton, K. Thurston, N. Walter, R.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a school or LEA may not: 45 (a) prohibit a parent of a child from accessing the child's education record; or 46 (b) without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record 47 regarding a student's gender identity that does not conform with the student's sex.
passages.note: Operative text guarantees parental access to records and consent for record changes, not notification or consent for staff use of names/pronouns; same near-unanimous vote.

rows.reasoning: Thurston's only record is a Yea on SB 100 (2023), which bars schools from blocking a parent's access to the education record and from changing gender-identity entries without written parental consent; the 59-6 vote is near-unanimous and cannot seat a chair alone. Even on its text it does not match "Require schools to notify parents" or "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" clause for clause.
